findings.title: A gradient-boosting challenger outperforms the champion by 0.0323 AUC
findings.narrative: The challenger's test AUC of 0.7735 exceeds the champion's 0.7412 by more than the 0.03 effective-challenge threshold. The champion's additive logit appears to miss an interaction, most plausibly between utilisation and current delinquency. Recommendation: test an interaction term or a spline on utilisation in the champion and document the choice.
